attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Maine corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (factor presence standards).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold (factor presence standards); result.me_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.me_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maine state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. ME requires addback of IRC 199A, depreciation differences. ME allows federal bond interest subtraction, ME municipal bond interest, dividend deduction.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maine state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.me_state_additions = 0.0; if result.me_section_199a_addback != 0.0 then set result.me_state_additions = result.me_state_additions + result.me_section_199a_addback; endif set result.me_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.me_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.me_state_subtractions = result.me_state_subtractions + result.me_us_interest_income; endif if result.me_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.me_state_subtractions = result.me_state_subtractions + result.me_municipal_interest; endif add (("Maine additions: $" + string value of (result.me_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.me_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.me_state_additions xdef { result.me_state_additions result.me_section_199a_addback f+ cvd /result.me_state_additions xdef } {} result.me_section_199a_addback 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.me_state_subtractions xdef { result.me_state_subtractions result.me_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.me_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.me_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse { result.me_state_subtractions result.me_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.me_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.me_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Maine additions: $" result.me_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.me_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maine corporate income tax. Applies graduated rates (3.5%, 7.5%, 8.3%, 8.93%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.me_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Maine corporate tax (graduated rates); Apply Maine graduated rates (3.5%, 7.5%, 8.3%, 8.93%)
action_details.action_dsl: set result.me_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.me_apportioned_income + result.me_state_additions - result.me_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.me_tier1_tax = (the minimum of (result.me_taxable_income) and (350000.0)) * result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier1; set result.me_tier2_tax = 0.0; set result.me_tier3_tax = 0.0; set result.me_tier4_tax = 0.0; if result.me_taxable_income > 350000.0 then set result.me_tier2_tax = ((the minimum of (result.me_taxable_income) and (1050000.0)) - 350000.0) * result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier2; endif if result.me_taxable_income > 1050000.0 then set result.me_tier3_tax = ((the minimum of (result.me_taxable_income) and (3500000.0)) - 1050000.0) * result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier3; endif if result.me_taxable_income > 3500000.0 then set result.me_tier4_tax = (result.me_taxable_income - 3500000.0) * result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier4; endif set result.me_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.me_tier1_tax + result.me_tier2_tax + result.me_tier3_tax + result.me_tier4_tax - result.me_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.me_refund_or_owed = result.me_estimated_payments - result.me_tax_liability; add "Maine taxable income: $" + string value of (result.me_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Maine tax liability (graduated rates 3.5%-8.93%): $" + string value of (result.me_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.me_apportioned_income result.me_state_additions f+ result.me_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.me_taxable_income xdef result.me_taxable_income 350000.0 fmin result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier1 fmul cvd /result.me_tier1_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.me_tier2_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.me_tier3_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.me_tier4_tax xdef { result.me_taxable_income 1050000.0 fmin 350000.0 f- result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier2 fmul cvd /result.me_tier2_tax xdef } {} result.me_taxable_income 350000.0 f> ifelse { result.me_taxable_income 3500000.0 fmin 1050000.0 f- result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier3 fmul cvd /result.me_tier3_tax xdef } {} result.me_taxable_income 1050000.0 f> ifelse { result.me_taxable_income 3500000.0 f- result.me_corp_tax_rate_tier4 fmul cvd /result.me_tier4_tax xdef } {} result.me_taxable_income 3500000.0 f> ifelse result.me_tier1_tax result.me_tier2_tax result.me_tier3_tax result.me_tier4_tax f+ result.me_state_credits f- f+ f+ 0.0 fmax cvd /result.me_tax_liability xdef result.me_estimated_payments result.me_tax_liability f- cvd /result.me_refund_or_owed xdef "Maine taxable income: $" result.me_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Maine tax liability (graduated rates 3.5%-8.93%): $" result.me_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
